reviewer: Codex manual text cover and motion-sheet review
observation: Orange lettering sits on a thick deep-red outline with a slight clockwise tilt; its warm red silhouette is distinct from the gold serif style.
method: Compared eight actual 320x180 rendered covers and aligned five-frame motion sheets at 0.08, 0.30, 0.55, 0.85 and 1.15 seconds; checked titles remain legible through the common fade.; schema extension: zero-sized panel preserves previous rendering
